digest.component_or_area: LLM provider layer - Bedrock native support
propositions: Rebar lacks a first-class native Bedrock provider; current workaround uses OpenAI-compatible gateway which loses prompt caching and native structured output.

Bedrock prompt caching succeeds silently (cache_read=0, cache_write=0) for some models while billing full input tokens every call, requiring an explicit warning when cache counters are both zero despite caching being requested.

Bedrock model us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 and some others reject temperature parameter with 400 ValidationException (deprecated for this model), causing hard failure on rebar Pass-2 verify steps which deliberately send temperature=0 for greedy determinism.

The Bedrock builder must live in a separate module (src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py) rather than providers.py to avoid breaching its 300-LOC signed criterion; only a registry entry goes in providers.py.

Prompt caching on Bedrock must use exactly two keys (bedrock_cache_instructions, bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with direct-Anthropic path, deliberately excluding bedrock_cache_messages which would enable caching behavior not present in the Anthropic path.

Model-specific sampling-parameter rejection (400 ValidationException containing parameter name + rejection keyword) must be caught and translated to LLMConfigError with remedies, distinguishing it from unrelated 400 failures that stay as LLMUnavailableError.
